1. alimentary — English adjective

Standard: 营养的／与营养有关的；供养、维持生计的（限定义）。

History: Latin alimentum/alimentarius; French alimentaire and New Latin alimentarius as borrowing sources for English alimentary, first recorded 1608. Preserve adjective identity; no forced stages for every spelling.

Source: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/alimentary

Candidates: 营养的 yíngyǎng de (nutrition adjective, Semantic High); 养 yǎng (nourish/sustain conceptual unit, Medium, not adjective equivalence); 供养的 gōngyǎng de (maintenance sense only, Medium). Chinese 养 online entry: https://zdic.net/hans/养 . Other exact phrase entries Pending.

Controls: 食物 shíwù has food meaning but noun/adjective mismatch; 阿 ā shares an onset segment without meaning. Strong counterexample: alimentary canal = 消化道, not a mechanically translated “养管”. ALIMENT family evidence can locate sources, not transfer its Chinese candidate or Featured.

Recommendation: **Featured Pending**. No consonant expansion appropriate for this vowel-initial whole word; do not invent a sliced historical unit.

2. 六十四卦 — Chinese cultural/symbolic object

Standard identity: 《周易》六十四卦、卦画及相关文字；not a foreign lexical item requiring a Chinese equivalent.

Original imported observation includes “六十四卦图是我们的另一种文字。所有卦象都是从乾卦而来。” Attribution remains unknown. Preserve wording, but separate literary interpretation from historical assertion.

Sources: received 《系辞》 structural account, https://p2.hbtv.com.cn/pcms/explorer/files/guoxue/zy.pdf (indexed text); modern symbol inventory https://www.unicode.org/charts/PDF/U4DC0.pdf . Unicode evidence establishes encoding only. Ancient formation dating remains unadjudicated.

Serious interpretations: (1) six binary positions yield 64 combinations, a structural calculation; (2) a cultural symbolic repertoire; (3) “another writing” as literary interpretation. None establishes full language-writing equivalence or a universal historical derivation from 乾. No artificial Chinese candidate list or phonetic rating for this same-language object.

Controls: encoding a symbol does not establish a writing system; constructing all combinations from one starting pattern does not establish historical origin. Different interpretative traditions must not be collapsed into chronology.

Recommendation: **Featured Pending**, retain Cultural–Structural–Literary research object; reject unsupported factual upgrade, not the original note. Consonant expansion not applicable.

original_observation.original_value: 英语：sky n. 天；汉语：盖【gai】n.。六十四卦图是我们的另一种文字。所有卦象都是从乾卦而来。附乾卦原文、坤卦标题、天字字源说明、盖天说、《敕勒歌》，以及站在山上仰望白云、房屋如舢板与邮轮、大地母亲的肌肤与骨骼、蓝天是被盖的文学段落。原稿另将卫星、电离层和平流层并置为所仰望的盖天结构；编辑版将古代模型、现代大气层与地球外部空间分开说明。

3. alimenter — French transitive verb

Standard: 供给食物／养活；供应；引申持续支撑、助长。

History: Latin alimentare attested from fourth century per TLFi; medieval French nourishment and provision of necessities; modern technical/figurative uses recorded separately. Do not claim all extensions occurred in a single ordered chain.

Source: https://www.cnrtl.fr/definition/alimenter (indexed TLFi article; some direct page requests empty).

Candidates: 养 yǎng (living recipient, High); 供 gōng (supply necessities/input, High); 助长 zhùzhǎng (limited figurative construction, Medium, negative connotation not always shared). https://zdic.net/hans/养 ; https://zdic.net/hans/供 . 助长 item-specific evidence Pending. Fix gōng, not gòng.

Controls: 供给 gōngjǐ, semantic strong/sound weak; 阿 ā, sound-only segment. Counterexample: alimenter une machine or une polémique is not feeding a person. ALIMENT family locator reused, modern verb and adjective conclusions independent.

Recommendation: **Featured Pending**. Consonant expansion not applicable to vowel-initial whole form without a justified comparison unit.

4. 神农氏人身牛头 — cultural tradition

Standard identity: 神农人身牛首传说；not literal biological or historical fact.

Source reopened: https://www.shidianguji.com/mid-page/7557480168089042982 . 明代陈嘉谟《图像本草蒙筌》digital transcription explicitly attests 人身牛首. Underlying edition/image not independently checked; Pending. This dates the inspected attestation, not the origin of the tradition.

Original NEW raw-note context also mentions Nibiru/Anunnaki. Preserve as imported raw speculation with unknown author. No independent evidence found here linking those traditions; do not promote to historical contact, common origin or English new etymology.

Serious interpretations: attested mythic description; cultural human/animal composite imagery. Controls: mythic anatomy is not biological evidence; shared bull imagery is not evidence of contact. No forced lexical mapping or sound score.

Recommendation: **Featured Pending**, retain cultural record and the negative-evidence boundary. Reuse NEW source locator only; no inherited Featured. Expansion not applicable.

original_observation.original_value: New，新的。牛 niu。丑牛时辰为一天新的开始。English new adj. 新的；French nouveau adj. 新的；Chinese 牛 n.。子鼠丑牛。子不代表新，牛时辰是新的开始。另提及 Nibiru/Anunnaki 与神农氏人身牛头。原始推想仅留档：Not evidence for etymology or historical relation。

5. couvent — French masculine noun

Standard: 修道院／修会会院；宗教共同体（转喻）；旧女子宗教寄宿学校义另列。Exclude homographic couver conjugation.

History: convenire assembling family; Latin conventus / ecclesiastical conventum are the differing citation forms preserved in consulted dictionaries; Old French convent/cuvent, twelfth century; modern community/residence senses. Do not silently merge all modern institution meanings with the assembly stage.

Sources: https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9C4710 ; https://www.cnrtl.fr/lexicographie/couvent (indexed TLFi).

Candidates: 修道院 xiūdàoyuàn (residence, High); 会众 huìzhòng (community, Medium, institutional scope limited); 聚 jù (historical assembling operation, Medium, not modern building translation). Individual Mainland Chinese paper/entry verification remains Pending.

Controls: 宗教共同体, semantic strong/sound weak; 口 kǒu, onset-only mismatch. Expansion: 宫 gōng via g-k-h, rejected semantic mismatch—partial religious-building overlap is not convent identity. Counterexample: couvent can house men; English female-associated usage must not be imposed on French.

Recommendation: **Featured Pending**. CONVENT family research reusable, Chinese conclusions not inherited.

6. forme — French feminine noun

Standard: 形状／形态；形式、体能状态等另义。Exclude former verb inflections.

History: Latin forma → French forme (eleventh century per Académie). No speculative deeper origin or forced Abstract→Concrete chronology.

Source: https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9F1288

Candidates: 形 xíng (external configuration, High); 型 xíng (mould/model sense, Medium); 式 shì (formal arrangement/manner sense, Medium). 形 evidence: https://zdic.net/hans/形 and https://zdic.net/hans/形状 . 型/式 exact scoped entry verification Pending.

Controls: 形状 xíngzhuàng semantic baseline, weak sound; 风 fēng phonetic-onset/meaning mismatch. Expansion: 方 fāng via b-p-m-f not selected; square is only one shape, not general form. Counterexample: être en forme concerns fitness, not “有形”.

Recommendation: **Featured Candidate = 形 xíng**, Structural-Semantic, external-configuration sense only; Phonetic Low. This is independently proposed from French sense evidence, not inherited English FORM Featured. Requires Jinkai review.

7. generation — English noun

Standard: 产生／生成；生育；一代／世代；技术代次。Not French génération.

History: Latin generare/generatio; Anglo-French generacion and Latin sources for Middle English generacioun, English first use fourteenth century per MW. Modern senses are separate, not a fabricated temporal chain.

Source: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/generation

Candidates: 生 shēng (birth/coming into being, High); 代 dài (cohort/descent/device generation, High); 生成 shēngchéng (production, High). Candidate-specific Chinese paper lexicographic evidence Pending; semantic proposals do not pretend to be completed deep verification.

Controls: 世代 shìdài semantic strong/sound weak; 根 gēn superficially resembles gen spelling but does not establish English /dʒ/ correspondence. Counterexample: power generation means 发电, not 世代; third generation is not three acts of birth.

Recommendation: **Featured Pending**. GENERATE family can be reused; gan/gun/gin/gen root speculation is not restored. No g-k-h expansion merely from the letter g.

8. média — French masculine noun

Standard: 媒体／传播媒介；singular un média, plural médias.

History: twentieth-century shortening/borrowing of American English mass media. Latin medium/media is remote family background through English, not a direct French donor or French plural rule.

Source: https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9M1495

Candidates: 媒体 méitǐ (communication medium, High); 媒 méi (connecting/intermediating entity, Medium–High in communication scope); 传播媒介 chuánbō méijiè (phrase equivalent, High). Chinese evidence: https://zdic.net/hans/媒 basic/detailed sections explicitly distinguish matchmaker and connecting entity. Paper-edition verification remains Pending.

Controls: 传播工具 semantic strong/sound weak; 煤 méi same Chinese sound but coal is irrelevant. Expansion: 模 mó via b-p-m-f rejected semantic mismatch (model/mould, not communication medium). 媒 itself came from semantic retrieval, not credited as expansion-added.

Recommendation: **Featured Candidate = 媒 méi**, limited Structural-Semantic comparison in intermediary/communication sense; Phonetic Low, only partial initial resemblance. French evidence assessed separately from legacy MEDIA. Counterexamples: Latin media plural versus French média singular; matchmaker is not a mass medium.
